title: Beyond the 956: Christian Cousins, ‘Kindergarten Cop’ child star, dies at 43
excerpt: Christian Cousins, the former child actor who played Dominic in Kindergarten Cop alongside Arnold Schwarzenegger, died October 20, 2026, at 43 after a battle with liver disease. His brother Jonas Roeser announced the death.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Christian Cousins, the former child actor best known for playing Dominic in the 1990 hit film Kindergarten Cop alongside Arnold Schwarzenegger, has died at 43.

Cousins died October 20, 2026, after a battle with liver disease, according to reports. His half-brother, Jonas Roeser, announced the death in an Instagram tribute in October, writing, “It’s hard to share that my brother, Christian Cousins, has passed away.” Roeser said Christian “had been very sick” with liver disease and remembered him as “full of passion and energy, with big stories and even bigger dreams.”

Born in March 1983 in Orange County, California, Cousins made his television debut in 1987 as Bobby Gibson on the CBS soap opera Knots Landing. His breakout came in 1990, when he and his twin brother, Joseph “Joey” Cousins, shared the role of Dominic Palmieri in Kindergarten Cop, the Ivan Reitman comedy starring Schwarzenegger as a detective going undercover as a kindergarten teacher. The twins won a Young Artist Award for the role.

Cousins went on to appear in Critters 3 (1991), Intruders (1992) and Twin Sitters (1994). His last on-screen role was in 1995. In 2020, he took part in a Kindergarten Cop reunion organized by Yahoo Entertainment, recalling his first meeting with director Ivan Reitman and Schwarzenegger.

Sources: Page Six; Parade; TV Insider; UNILAD; statement from Jonas Roeser on Instagram.
